title: A Archive for the Vector
author: Ulyana Crane
blurb: Hazel Whitlock, a starship navigator haunted by the backups sleeping in the hold, has spent ten years hauling cargo through contested orbits. But when the station AI begins confessing to crimes nobody reported, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
